model_annotation: This grouped bar chart illustrates the negative log probability of per-specialty medical terms across six medical specialties, comparing a base model (Mistralv0.2-Base) against versions fine-tuned on each of the six specialties. The horizontal axis is labeled "Per-specialty terms" and contains six categorical groups: Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics. The vertical axis is labeled "Negative log probability" and uses a linear scale ranging from approximately -27 to -22, with tick marks at integer intervals. Within each group on the horizontal axis, there are seven bars representing the base model and six fine-tuned variants. The base model (Mistralv0.2-Base) is shown in a light blue color, while the fine-tuned models are color-coded as follows: Cardio in light yellow, Gastro in light pink/peach, Infect in light orange, Neuro in medium orange, Obstetrics in dark orange/brown, and Pediatrics in dark brown. Across most specialty term groups, the bars extend downward from approximately -22 to varying depths, with most fine-tuned models reaching values between approximately -22 and -24.5. The base model bar (light blue) consistently extends deeper, typically reaching values around -25.5 to -26.5, making it the longest bar in nearly every group. For example, in the Cardio group, the fine-tuned model bars cluster around -22 to -24, while the base model bar extends to approximately -26. A similar pattern is visible in the Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics groups, where the base model bar is notably longer than the fine-tuned variants. The bars are not sorted by value within each group but rather follow a consistent ordering matching the legend sequence. No bars appear to be individually annotated or visually emphasized beyond their color coding.
